ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can integrate vast volumes of observations, but scientists still decide when a process model is likely to fail and how to communicate the conclusion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 9,400 Atmospheric Scientists, Including Meteorologists employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 9,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with roughly 700 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $97,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace atmospheric scientists, but it will accelerate model post-processing. Data assimilation, graphic generation, and error correction speed up repetitive work, shifting scientists from running models and producing charts toward modeling, error judgment, operational decisions, and interdisciplinary explanation. Routine charting and simple forecasts face the most pressure. Professionals who can build models and explain results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Modeling mechanisms: people understand the physics.
Error judgment: people verify the models.
Operational decisions: people determine the conclusions.
Interdisciplinary explanation: people tailor the message to the audience.
System maintenance: people monitor operational stability.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10, moderate, places this occupation in a data-intensive exposure range. Assimilation and charting systems accelerate the workflow, while modeling and decisions still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Routine charting and simple forecasting tasks face replacement, not roles centered on model building and explanation. Professionals with modeling skills who can take responsibility for operational decisions become scarcer as efficiency rises. Roles limited to producing charts face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with an atmospheric science bachelor's degree, and study programming and models while in school. Pure chart-production work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop modeling skills early.
Advance from producing charts to building models and making decisions. Learn AI post-processing and work toward lead forecaster responsibilities.
Emphasize modeling and data experience, and name the systems you have worked with. Employers value operational stability and rigor.
Do not assess candidates on education alone. Test whether they can build models and explain results. Lead forecasters who can take responsibility for operational decisions justify premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Climate change and extreme weather are increasing demand.
AI handles post-processing while people build models.
Professionals with modeling skills are in greater demand.

body: Atmospheric Scientists, Including Meteorologists study physical and chemical processes in the atmosphere. They use numerical models, satellite data, and sounding observations for weather forecasting, climate analysis, and air-quality assessment, informing decisions in aviation, disaster prevention, energy, and research.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can integrate vast volumes of observations, but scientists still decide when a process model is likely to fail and how to communicate the conclusion.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你融合海量观测，但哪次过程模式会崩、结论怎么讲，还是科学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年大气科学家（含气象学家）在岗约 0.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.95 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代大气科学家，但会加速模式后处理。数据同化、图形生成和误差订正把重复工作提速，科学家从「跑模式出图」挪向「建模、误差判断、业务决策、跨域解释」。真正被挤掉的是常规制图与简单预报，有建模能力能解释的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 预报结论的自然语言生成
ai_s3_list: 建模机理：物理靠人懂。
误差判断：模式靠人核。
业务决策：结论靠人定。
跨域解释：给谁讲靠人说。
系统维护：稳不稳靠人盯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的数据区——同化制图为系统加速，但建模与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规制图与简单预报」动作，不是「建模解释」的岗位。有模式能力、能扛业务决策的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会出图的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 大气科学本科打底，在校多学编程和模式。AI 时代纯制图在缩，早点练建模。
从「出图」升级成「建模式 + 做决策」，学 AI 后处理，争取当首席。
突出模式与数据经验，写清跟过哪些系统。单位看重稳和严谨。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会建模解释。能扛业务决策的首席，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 气候与极端天气推高需求。
AI 替后处理，人做建模。
有模式能力的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule production and predict equipment failures, but a manager still decides whether to change the formulation when feedstock prices rise and whether to start an additional production line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 241,900 production managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 246,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,600 jobs, with approximately 17,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $121,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace biofuels production managers, but it will upgrade their management tools. Intelligent scheduling, process optimization, and predictive maintenance are taking over reporting and dispatch, shifting managers from watching reports and chasing progress toward operating decisions, exception response, and team leadership. Production management centers on judgment and accountability, which AI cannot replace. Managers who use intelligent systems work more efficiently.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic aggregation and analysis of production reports
Automatic aggregation of energy-use and cost data
ai_s3_list: Operating judgment: balance feedstock price increases against order volatility.
Decisive exception response: stop lines, organize emergency repairs, and protect safety without hesitation.
Team leadership: schedule crews, develop people, and strengthen morale.
Deep process experience: understand which stage of the production line is likely to fail.
Safety and compliance accountability: the manager bears primary responsibility for accidents.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means reporting and dispatch in this occupation are becoming digital. AI and software support production scheduling, process monitoring, and data aggregation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. AI takes over data and process tasks, leaving decisions and accountability to managers. Pure dispatch-management roles shrink, while managers who understand processes, operate the business, and lead teams become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose an undergraduate major such as chemical engineering, bioengineering, or energy, then add management knowledge. Seek factory internships during breaks to learn both processes and front-line operations.

Learn intelligent scheduling, digital twins, and predictive-maintenance systems, and take responsibility for operating metrics. Advance from production dispatch to operations management and earn relevant safety or quality credentials.

A background in chemical manufacturing or manufacturing management is ideal. Another route is starting as a process technician or shift supervisor. On your resume, describe the production lines you managed, their output, and the major exceptions you handled.
When hiring production managers, look beyond tenure to exception response and commercial awareness. Managers willing to learn intelligent-factory tools merit strong retention compensation.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: View output and cost on one screen

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent-factory management becomes widespread, shifting production managers from watching reports and chasing progress toward operating decisions and exception response. Data dashboards become standard tools.
Carbon-neutrality policies expand the biofuels industry, increasing demand for managers who understand processes, operate businesses, and lead teams.
AI-based predictive maintenance and digital twins enter production, turning production managers into multidisciplinary leaders who combine processes, digital systems, and operations.

body: Biofuels production managers coordinate production plans and daily operations in biofuel plants. They manage process control, output and quality, costs, equipment maintenance, and team scheduling, serving as core leaders who keep green-energy production lines stable and efficient.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule production and predict equipment failures, but a manager still decides whether to change the formulation when feedstock prices rise and whether to start an additional production line.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动排产、能预测设备故障，但「原料涨价了要不要调配方、这条产线到底加不加开」——拍板的那个决定，还得经理来做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生产经理在岗约 24.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 24.65 万人，净增约 0.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物燃料生产经理，但会升级管理工具。智能排产、工艺优化、预测性维护正在接走报表和调度环节，经理从「盯报表、催进度」转向「经营决策、异常处置、团队管理」。生产管理的核心是决策和担责——这是 AI 替代不了的，会用智能系统的经理效率更高。
ai_s2_accel: 数字孪生优化工艺流程
智能工厂管理平台普及
ai_s2_auto: 生产报表自动汇总分析
工艺参数自动监控预警
能耗与成本数据自动归集
ai_s3_list: 经营决策的判断：原料涨价、订单波动，怎么权衡。
异常处置的果断：停线、抢修、保安全，不能犹豫。
带团队的能力：班组怎么排、人怎么带、士气怎么提。
工艺吃透的经验：产线哪一环容易出问题，心里有数。
安全与合规的责任：出了事故，经理是第一责任人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的报表与调度环节正在被数字化——排产、工艺监控、数据汇总，AI 和系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「数据和流程」环节，留下的是「决策和担责」环节。纯调度型管理岗会被压缩，懂工艺、会经营、能带团队的经理反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 本科选化学工程、生物工程或能源专业，再补管理知识。假期争取去工厂实习，把工艺和一线都摸一遍。
把智能排产、数字孪生和预测性维护系统学起来，主动扛经营指标。从「生产调度」升级为「运营管理」，考安全/质量相关证书。
有化工或制造管理背景最好，可从工艺员、值班长切入再往上走。简历上多写「管过什么产线、产量多少、处理过什么重大异常」。
招生产经理别只看资历，要看异常处置和经营意识。愿意学智能工厂工具的经理，值得高薪留。

ai_s7_trends: 智能工厂管理普及，生产经理从「盯报表、催进度」转向「经营决策、异常处置」，数据驾驶舱成为标配工具。
碳中和政策推动生物燃料产业扩张，懂工艺、会经营、能带团队的经理更抢手。
AI 预测性维护与数字孪生落地，生产经理向「工艺+数字化+经营」复合管理者转变。

body: 生物燃料生产经理统筹生物燃料工厂的生产计划与日常运营，负责工艺控制、产量质量、成本管理、设备维护与团队调度，是保障绿色能源产线稳定高效运转的核心管理岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can narrow a fault from diagnostic codes and operating data, but a mechanic still has to inspect the engine directly before deciding whether to dismantle it or replace worn parts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 319,900 bus and truck mechanics and diesel engine specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 327,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 7,800 jobs, with approximately 26,500 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $60,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Bus And Truck Mechanics And Diesel Engine Specialists, but it will make diagnosis faster. Fault-code interpretation, remote data monitoring, and maintenance scheduling are becoming more intelligent. Mechanics move from checking components one by one to making precise repairs guided by data. The scarce capabilities are rebuilding engines and chassis systems and judging whether a part should be repaired or replaced.
ai_s2_accel: Remote fleet-data monitoring and anomaly alerts
AI-assisted diagnosis of electrical and electronic-control faults
Intelligent search of repair manuals and fault cases
Upgraded diagnostic tools for electric powertrain systems
ai_s2_auto: Parts lookup, ordering, and inventory management
Digital repair records and vehicle histories
ai_s3_list: Engine rebuilding: liners, bearings, and valve clearances require skilled hands and precise measuring tools.
Experienced judgment: data identifies possibilities, while experience identifies the fault. Accuracy requires both.
Road-test judgment: a drive, careful listening, and physical inspection reveal whether the repair worked.
Safety accountability: one brake bolt can affect every life on the bus.
Multi-system expertise: mechanics must integrate mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic faults.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, means AI greatly accelerates data tasks such as code reading, scheduling, and parts management. Physical rebuilding remains demanding, skilled work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Tools and outsourcing pressure parts-replacement roles, while technicians who rebuild engines and diagnose electronic controls remain sought after. The transition to electric vehicles is a larger variable, favoring people who keep learning.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Automotive or engine-repair programs offer practical training and strong employment prospects. Learn electronic-control diagnostics and electric powertrain systems alongside combustion engines because commercial-vehicle electrification will continue.

Move beyond the comfort zone of combustion engines and learn electric-truck repair and powertrain systems. Master diagnostic computers and AI fault-analysis tools. Rebuilding plus electronic controls plus electric vehicles creates the strongest combination.

Automotive-repair or mechanical experience provides an entry point. Begin with commercial-vehicle maintenance and routine service, then earn relevant credentials. The field needs technicians who study difficult problems and handle physical work.

Do not hire technicians on years of service alone. Assess how many engines they have independently rebuilt and whether they diagnose electronic controls. Training experienced mechanics on electric vehicles and new equipment is the most practical investment in the transition.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid lookup of similar fault cases
Parts lookup, ordering, and inventory alerts
Scheduling, work assignment, and closed-loop tracking

ai_s7_trends: Electric trucks and new-energy buses are spreading faster, while demand for combustion-engine rebuilding peaks and begins to decline.
Remote diagnosis and AI fault analysis spread as mechanics shift toward electronic controls plus electric powertrains.
Retirements create shortages among experienced mechanics, increasing the bargaining power of younger technicians with electric-vehicle skills.

body: Bus And Truck Mechanics And Diesel Engine Specialists inspect, maintain, and repair buses, trucks, and other commercial vehicles. Their work centers on diagnosing and repairing diesel engines, drivetrains, brakes, and electrical systems.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从故障码和运行数据里圈出问题范围，但「这台发动机拆不拆、哪里磨损到该换了」，还得机械师上手摸过再定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公交卡车机械师发动机专员在岗约 31.99 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.77 万人，净增约 0.78 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.65 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.06 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代公交卡车机械师，但会让诊断更快。故障码解析、远程数据监控、保养排期都越来越智能，机械师从「挨个查」转向「按数据精准修」。真正稀缺的，是把诊断结果落到发动机和底盘上的拆修手艺，以及判断「该修还是该换」的经验。
ai_s2_accel: 远程车队数据监控与异常预警
AI 辅助的电路与电控故障定位
维修手册与故障案例的智能检索
新能源三电系统的诊断工具升级
ai_s2_auto: 故障码读取与自动解析
保养周期的系统化排期与提醒
备件查询、下单与库存管理
维修记录与车辆档案的数字化
ai_s3_list: 发动机拆修手艺：缸套、轴承、气门间隙，全靠手上功夫和量具说话。
经验判断：数据说「可能」，经验说「就这个」，两者结合才准。
路试与试车判断：修得好不好，开一圈、听一听、摸一摸就知道。
安全责任：刹车上的一颗螺栓，关系到一车人的命。
多系统综合能力：机械、电气、液压拧在一起的问题，要能统筹。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的数据环节——读码、排期、备件——正被 AI 大幅提速，但拆修本体仍是重体力、重手艺的活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低-中风险不等于没变化：纯换件工会被工具和外包挤压，而能大修发动机、会电控诊断的技师始终抢手。新能源转型是更大的变量，学得动新东西的人才能吃到下一波。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 汽修或发动机维修专业实用性强，就业不愁。除了燃油机基础，把电控诊断和新能源三电课程提前学起来，商用车电动化是必然方向。
别停在燃油机舒适区，主动补新能源卡车维修和新三电知识。把诊断电脑和 AI 故障分析工具用熟，大修 + 电控 + 新能源组合是最强竞争力。
有汽修或机械基础就能切入，先从商用车保养和例保做起，考取相关证书逐步升级。商用车维修缺人，但缺的是肯钻研、扛得住体力活的技师。
招技师别只看年限，要看独立大修过多少台发动机、会不会电控诊断。给老师傅配新能源培训和新设备，是应对转型最实际的投资。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 故障码解析、数据流读取
ai_s6_tools.工具: 诊断电脑/故障码读取器

ai_s7_trends: 电动卡车与新能源公交渗透加快，燃油大修需求见顶回落。
远程诊断与 AI 故障分析普及，机械师向「电控 + 三电」转型。
老技师退休带来缺口，会新能源的年轻技师议价力上升。

body: 公交卡车机械师、柴油发动机专员负责公共汽车、卡车等商用车辆的检测、保养与修理，重点涵盖柴油发动机、传动系统、制动与电气系统的故障诊断与维修。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can handle lesson preparation and initial grading, but teachers still decide which classes inspire students and where research should go.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 74,900 Education Teachers, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 76,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,600 jobs, with about 5,600 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $72,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Education Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will accelerate lesson preparation and grading. Systems speed up source collection, question generation, and initial assessment. Teaching can shift from writing lecture notes to stimulating discussion, advising research, and exercising academic judgment. Instructors who only read slides face pressure, while those who both teach and research are more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Instructional inspiration: people ignite curiosity.
Research judgment: people choose the direction.
Thesis review: people protect quality.
Student advising: people guide growth.
Academic communication: people exercise tact.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate lesson preparation and grading, while people retain responsibility for teaching and research.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI accelerates lecture-note drafting and initial grading, not the teaching and research position itself. Faculty who teach well, conduct research, and exercise academic judgment become scarcer as productivity rises. Instructors who only read slides face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: During doctoral study, practice both research and teaching. Reading from a script is losing value in the AI era, so develop discussion and instructional skills early.
Move from reading slides to leading research and stimulating discussion, and build a record of results.
Highlight publications and courses, and specify the students you have advised.
Do not assess candidates only by credentials. Evaluate both teaching and research ability.

ai_s7_trends: Lesson preparation is becoming fully digital
Declining birth rates constrain public-sector staffing
Faculty who both teach and research are in greater demand

body: Education Teachers, Postsecondary teach education courses and guide research. They use disciplinary knowledge and instructional methods to pass educational theory and empirical research to future teachers and researchers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能管备课与评阅，但哪堂课能启发人、研究往哪走，还是教师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 7.49 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.65 万人，净增约 0.16 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.56 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代教育学科高校教师，但会加速备课评阅。系统把资料、出题、初评提速，教学从「写讲义」挪向「启发讨论、研究指导、学术判断」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的，能教能研的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 教学启发：点燃靠人。
研究判断：方向靠人。
论文把关：质量靠人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace healthcare social workers, but it will accelerate documentation and matching. Electronic records, resource databases, and follow-up reminders reduce repetitive work, shifting social workers from forms and resource searches toward crisis intervention, empathetic support, multidisciplinary coordination, and discharge planning. Data entry and simple referrals face pressure, while clinical judgment and empathy become more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Data entry and simple referrals are replaceable, not clinical social judgment. ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: L2 driver assistance can keep a truck following steadily on the highway, but drivers must still react when wind shifts a cone at an exit or an unusual sound comes from the trailer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 2,235,100 heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers in 2024, projected to rise to 2,324,400 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 89,300 jobs, with roughly 237,600 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $57,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace truck drivers soon, but it will divide driving into two layers. Assistance handles highway cruising, while people remain responsible for loading, reversing, complex roads, and emergencies. Autonomous trucks are being piloted on closed routes in North America and China, but full autonomy remains constrained by regulation, road complexity, and cost. Human-machine driving is already arriving.
ai_s2_accel: L2+ driver assistance spreads on long-haul routes
Truck platooning pilots save fuel and improve speed
AI vision monitors driver fatigue and distraction
Autonomous trucks conduct test operations in closed facilities and highway routes
ai_s2_auto: Adaptive cruise and lane keeping handle highway cruising
Geofencing and route planning automatically generate optimal routes
Automatic alerts monitor tire pressure, fuel, and fault codes
Electronic bills of lading and delivery records are fully paperless
ai_s3_list: Complex-road driving: judge rain, fog, mountains, and narrow urban streets.
Reversing and loading: maneuver precisely into narrow docks and align freight.
Vehicle and cargo inspection: recognize unusual sounds, odors, and loose restraints.
Emergency response: calmly handle blowouts, shifted loads, and accident scenes.
Route and time coordination: balance deadlines, rest, and road conditions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure stage as driver assistance spreads rapidly. Systems share highway cruising, but loading, inspection, handoffs, and emergency response still require people. Jobs will remain, while pure driving shrinks and drivers add skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate risk still brings change. Drivers who use assistance, understand vehicle maintenance, and handle cargo anomalies and handoffs are more secure. Full autonomy will first affect highway-cruise-only drivers, while people who coordinate the complete transportation process become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Before entering, calculate the time cost. An A2 license has age and upgrade-experience requirements. Earnings build through mileage and experience, and the early years are demanding. Confirm a student can tolerate hardship and long-distance travel.

Learn driver-assistance systems, vehicle maintenance, and cargo-loss handling, then move toward dedicated routes, specialized transport, or fleet dispatch. Document safe mileage and customer relationships as assets for future transitions.

Before changing careers, assess how much long-distance work your health and family can tolerate. Begin with short-haul or urban distribution, gain experience, and then consider upgrading to A2 for long haul. Buying and affiliating a truck immediately is highly risky.
Evaluate safe mileage, driver-assistance use, and cargo-damage rates rather than deadlines alone. Reasonable rest protections retain long-haul drivers and control accidents.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: L2 辅助驾驶能让卡车在高速上稳稳跟车，但「前面匝道口的锥桶被风吹歪了、货厢里传来一声异响」——这些还是得司机一脚油门一脚刹自己判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年重型与半挂卡车司机在岗约 223.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 232.44 万人，净增约 8.93 万个岗位，年均产生约 23.76 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会在近期取代卡车司机，但会把「驾驶」这件事分成两层：高速公路的巡航交给辅助驾驶，装卸、倒车、复杂路况和突发处置仍由人负责。自动驾驶卡车已经在北美和国内的封闭干线试点，真正的完全无人化还卡在法规、路况复杂度和成本上，但「人机共驾」已经在路上发生了。

车辆与货物检查：异响、异味、固定松动的直觉判断。
突发处置：爆胎、货物倾斜、事故现场的冷静应对。
路线与时间的统筹：把时效、休息、路况安排明白。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业正处在「辅助驾驶快速渗透」的阶段：高速巡航被系统分担，但驾驶舱之外的工作——装卸、检查、交接、突发处置——短期内仍需人。岗位不会消失，但「纯驾驶」的部分会被压缩，司机需要叠加更多技能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没变化：会用辅助驾驶、懂车辆维护、能处理货物异常和交接的司机更稳。自动驾驶真到完全落地的那天，最先受影响的是「纯高速巡航司机」，而能统筹「运输全流程」的人反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 入行先算清楚时间成本：A2 证有年龄和增驾年限要求。这行收入靠里程和经验积累，前期辛苦，要确认孩子能吃苦、耐得住长途再考虑。
把辅助驾驶、车辆维保和货损处理学起来，往专线、特种运输或车队调度管理走。记录好安全里程和客户资源，这是你换赛道时的底气。
转行先评估身体和家庭能承受多少长途：从短途、城配司机做起积累经验，再考虑增驾 A2 跑长途。别一上来就买车上挂靠，风险很高。
把「安全里程 + 辅助驾驶使用 + 货损率」作为考核核心，而不是单纯拼时效。给长途司机合理的休息保障，才能留得住人、控得住事故。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can load fixtures automatically and systems can measure parts, but experienced workers still use their eyes and hands to decide when a tool needs replacement and how to sequence a batch efficiently.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 131,000 metal and plastic machine tool setters, operators, and tenders employed in 2024, projected to decline to 130,300 by 2034. That is a net loss of about 700 jobs, with roughly 12,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $46,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace multiple machine tool operators, but they will reshape the role. Robotic loading, automated measurement, and intelligent scheduling are taking over repetitive setup work, shifting operators from watching machines toward setup, programming, and exception handling. Coordinating multiple machines, diagnosing anomalies, and skilled setup remain irreplaceable human capabilities. Operators with CNC and programming expertise are more sought after.
ai_s2_accel: Coordinated operation of multiple machines on automated lines
ai_s3_list: Setup craftsmanship: setting tools, changing tools, and applying offsets correctly on the first attempt through experience.
Exception diagnosis: identifying the cause of abnormal sounds, tool deflection, or dimensional drift at a glance.
Multi-machine coordination: knowing instinctively how to sequence several machines efficiently.
Tooling and process experience: knowing which tool suits each material and avoiding unnecessary damage.
Quality awareness: one defective part requires inspection of the entire batch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means automation is taking over some repetitive steps, including fixturing, loading and unloading, and measurement, where robots and systems provide substantial support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure still carries risk. Automation will replace machine-watching-only roles, but setup, programming, and exception handling continue to depend on people. The real vulnerability is knowing only how to press buttons; multidisciplinary operators who set up machines, understand CNC, and handle anomalies remain more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study CNC or machining at technical or vocational school. Learn programming and machine setup together, and gain internship experience across several workshops and machine types.

Learn CNC programming, machine setup, and automated-line maintenance and proactively manage multiple machines. Advancing from operator to CNC technician + multiskilled worker significantly raises income.

Start as a single-machine operator, master one machine, and then learn another. On your resume, specify which machines you operate, which parts you have produced, and whether you have programming experience.
When hiring operators, look beyond how many machines they can watch to setup and learning ability. Young workers willing to learn CNC programming are worth developing into team leaders.

ai_s7_trends: As robotic loading and automated measurement spread, operators shift from watching machines toward setup, programming, and exception handling, making CNC skills standard.
Machining demand remains stable, and multiskilled operators who set up machines and coordinate multiple units are more sought after.
As intelligent scheduling and digital twins reach production, operators are becoming multidisciplinary specialists in automated-line maintenance + process programming.

body: Combination machine tool operators adjust, fixture, operate, and monitor multiple metal or plastic processing machines, completing multi-operation part machining and dimensional inspection as multiskilled operators in machine shops.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能自动装夹、系统能自动测量，但「这把刀该换了、这批活怎么排更顺」——车间里的判断，还得靠老师傅的眼睛和手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器工具铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 13.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.03 万人，岗位净减约 0.07 万个，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.61 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代多机床操作工，但会改变岗位形态。机器人上下料、自动测量、智能排产正在接走重复装夹环节，操作工从「看机器」转向「调机、编程、处理异常」。多机床协调、异常判断和调机手艺，是机器替代不了的核心——会数控、懂编程的操作工更吃香。
ai_s2_accel: 智能排产与 MES 覆盖
ai_s3_list: 调机的手艺：对刀、换刀、补正，靠经验一次调到位。
异常判断：异响、让刀、尺寸飘，原因一眼看准。
多机床协调：几台机器怎么排最顺，心里有张表。
刀具与工艺经验：什么料用什么刀，坏了不心疼。
质量意识：废一个件，整批都要查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业有一部分重复环节正在被自动化——装夹、上下料、测量，机器人和系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零风险。自动化确实会替代纯看机岗，但调机、编程和异常处理依然靠人。真正该担心的是「只会按开关」，会调机、懂数控、能处理异常的复合操作工更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走数控或机械加工专业，技校职高就够用。把编程和调机一起学，实习多跑几家车间练不同机床。
把数控编程、调机和自动化产线运维学起来，主动管多台设备。从「操作工」升级为「数控技师+多技能」，收入明显提升。
从单机操作工做起，学会一种机床再学下一种。简历上多写「会哪几种机床、加工过什么零件、有没有编程经验」。
招操作工别只看能看几台机，要看调机和学习能力。愿意学数控编程的年轻人，值得培养成班组骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 机器人上下料与自动测量普及，操作工从「看机器」转向「调机、编程、处理异常」，数控技能成为标配。
机械加工需求稳定，多技能、会调机、能协调多设备的操作工更抢手。
智能排产与数字孪生落地，操作工向「自动化产线运维+工艺编程」复合角色转变。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 489,300 construction equipment operators were employed in 2024. Emergency response: people adapt to change.
Multi-machine coordination: people coordinate the work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high exposure range. Systems accelerate repetitive cycles, but judgment and safety remain firmly human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Fixed-cycle driving is being replaced, not roles combining site conditions, blind spots, and precise placement. People with field judgment become scarcer as automation spreads.

Advance from operating one machine to multiple equipment types and safety expertise, and learn assistive systems.
Highlight operating certificates and equipment experience, specifying the projects you have worked on.
When hiring, look beyond boldness to the ability to read conditions and protect blind spots.

Driver assistance is becoming standard.
People with sound judgment are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代操作手，但会压缩重复动作。自动找平与遥控操作把标准循环提速，操作手从「纯驾驶」挪向「工况判断、盲区安全、精细落点、多机协同」。真正被挤掉的是只按固定循环的，会看工况能保安全的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「固定循环驾驶」，不是「工况 + 盲区 + 落点」的复合岗。有现场判断力的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。

从「单机会开」升级成「多机种 + 安全」，学辅助系统。
突出操作证和机种经验，写清跟过哪些项目。
选人别只看胆大，要看会不会看工况、守盲区。

ai_s7_trends: 遥控普及，循环缩。
辅助驾驶成标配。
会判断的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 85,900 security and fire alarm systems installers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 94,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,000 jobs, with approximately 9,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $59,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace installation work as a whole, but it will replace desk-based tasks such as drawings, device placement design, and equipment selection. System integration solutions are becoming more intelligent, while on-site wiring, equipment installation, and integrated commissioning still require people. The more complex the system becomes, the greater the need for people who understand its principles and can commission it.
ai_s2_accel: Remote monitoring and configuration deployment through intelligent platforms
Video analytics replaces some perimeter detection
Cloud-based fire protection IoT platform integration
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted device placement and automated drawing generation
Intelligent equipment selection and solution configuration
Automated circuit testing and report generation
Wireless alarm equipment installed without cabling
ai_s3_list: On-site construction judgment: assess real conditions for routing wires through walls and supporting equipment from ceilings.
Integrated commissioning: understand the logic across the entire chain from alarm to action.
Troubleshooting: trace open circuits and offline devices through each system layer.
Multi-trade coordination: communicate reliably with electrical, plumbing, interior finishing, and property teams.
Inspection and compliance: master fire inspection codes and deliver a compliant system.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 describes an occupation where desk work can be automated but field work depends on people. AI tools can assist with device placement design and solution configuration, while the physical and experience-based work of construction, commissioning, and maintenance remains central.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure reflects increasingly intelligent systems. Smart platforms will reduce labor in some construction steps but expand maintenance and commissioning demand. Installers who can program and commission systems, understand integration logic, and resolve faults will become more valuable in the intelligent-building era.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Training in low-voltage electrical systems, electrical work, or building intelligence is a strong choice. Build a solid foundation in electricity and fire codes, and earn electrician and fire protection facilities operator credentials early. As smart buildings become widespread, people who can commission systems will become scarcer.

Do not remain only a cabling worker. Learn alarm control panel programming, integrated commissioning, and IoT platforms, then advance toward fire protection engineering, project management, or maintenance. Credentials are this field's strongest entry passes.

People with an electrical foundation can transition fastest. Start in low-voltage installation and earn a fire protection facilities operator credential while working. In interviews, highlight experience independently completing integrated commissioning and resolving faults.

Do not recruit solely to the standard of cabling workers. Prioritize versatile installers who can commission systems, understand integration, and independently pass inspections. Use certification allowances + project commissions to retain core technical personnel.

ai_s7_trends: Stricter fire regulations and smart-city development sustain demand for alarm and security systems and accelerate intelligent-platform deployment.
Wireless devices and cloud platforms lower construction barriers, shifting the occupation's focus from cabling toward commissioning, integration, and maintenance.
As IoT fire protection and video analytics become widespread, versatile installers with platform and data operations skills command a clear premium.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年安全消防系统安装工在岗约 8.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.49 万人，净增约 0.90 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.94 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代整体安装工岗位，但会替掉图纸、点位设计、设备选型这些案头活。系统集成方案越来越智能，现场布线、设备安装、联动调试依然必须靠人——而且系统越复杂，越需要懂原理、会调试的人去兜底。
ai_s2_accel: 智能平台远程监控与配置下发
视频分析替代部分周界探测
AI 巡检识别设备故障
云端消防物联网平台联动
ai_s2_auto: AI 辅助点位布防与图纸自动生成
设备选型与方案配置智能化
回路测试与报告自动生成
无线报警设备免布线安装
ai_s3_list: 现场施工判断：墙内走线、吊顶承重，实打实的环境判断。
联动调试：报警到动作的整条链路，逻辑要理得清。
故障排查：回路不通、点位掉线，顺着系统一层层找。
多工种协调：跟水电、装修、物业配合，现场沟通要稳。
验收与合规：消防验收规范烂熟，交得出合格系统。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这是个「案头可自动化、现场靠人工」的岗位：点位设计、方案配置这些能被 AI 辅助，但施工、调试、维护的体力与经验部分仍是主体。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对应的是「系统越来越智能」的趋势——智能平台会减少施工环节的人工，但也会把维护和调试需求放大。会编程调试、懂联动逻辑、能处理故障的安装工，在智能化时代反而是增值的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子学弱电、电工、楼宇智能化方向不错，一定要把电气基础和消防规范学扎实，尽早考电工证和消防设施操作员证。智能楼宇越普及，会调试的人才越缺。
别停留在「布线工」。把报警主机编程、联动调试、物联网平台学会，往消防工程师、项目管理和维保方向走；证书是这行最硬的通行证。
有电工基础的转行最快。从弱电安装做起，边做边考消防设施操作员证；面试突出「独立完成过联动调试、处理过故障」的经历。
招人别只按布线工标准，重点找会调试、懂联动、能独立验收的复合型安装工。建议用「证书补贴 + 项目提成」留住技术骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 消防法规趋严与智慧城市推进，报警与安防系统需求持续增长，智能化平台加速落地。
无线设备与云平台降低施工门槛，岗位重心从布线转向调试、联动与维保。
物联网消防与视频分析普及，懂平台、会数据运维的复合型安装工溢价明显。

body: 安全与消防报警系统安装工负责安防监控、入侵报警与消防火灾自动报警系统的布线、设备安装、接线、编程调试与联动测试，确保系统在紧急情况下可靠动作。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动生成点位图和回路清单，但「这堵墙里穿不了线、那个吊顶承不住探测器」——这些现场判断，还得靠爬过竖井的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI skin analysis and home devices can assist, but specialists still determine technique, treatment plans, and the in-person experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 97,400 skincare specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 103,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,500 jobs, with about 14,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $41,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace skincare specialists, but it will reduce basic services. Home beauty devices and AI skin analysis move some cleansing and hydration home, shifting specialists toward customized plans, advanced devices, experience management, and customer retention. Standard-cleansing-only roles face displacement, while strong planners become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Hands-on experience: people create relaxation.
Customized plans: people assess skin types.
Customer relationships: people cultivate trust.
Advanced devices: people operate them.
Home-care advice: people follow up.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in experience services with moderately high AI exposure. Basic care moves outside salons, but hands-on technique and experience remain human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard cleansing, not the care experience. People who design plans and retain customers become scarcer. Standard-process-only specialists face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: During vocational training, practice hands-on techniques and skin knowledge. Pure cleansing is shrinking in the AI era, so learn plan design early.
Advance from basic care to plans + devices and study skin management.
Highlight customer care and approachability and list the treatments you have supported.
Do not select people only by technique; assess commercial judgment. Core staff who retain customers merit high commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Home devices move basic care outside salons.
In-person experiences and plans create opportunities.
Specialists with planning ability are increasingly sought after.

body: Skincare specialists provide cleansing, hydration, repair, and basic care in beauty and medical aesthetics facilities, combining products and devices to offer personalized skincare advice.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI skin analysis and home devices can assist, but specialists still determine technique, treatment plans, and the in-person experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 测肤和家用仪能辅助，但手法、方案与到店体验还是专员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年护肤专员在岗约 9.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.39 万人，净增约 0.65 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.45 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代护肤专员，但会压缩基础环节。家用美容仪与 AI 测肤把清洁补水部分外移，专员从「做基础」挪向「方案定制、仪器进阶、体验经营、客户留存」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准清洁的，有方案力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 手法体验：放松靠人。
方案定制：肤质靠人判。
客户经营：信任靠人养。
仪器进阶：操作靠人。
居家建议：跟进靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的体验区——基础护理被外移，但手法与体验还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准清洁」动作，不是「护理体验」的岗位。有方案力、能经营客户的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做标准流程的专员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职业培训多练手法和皮肤知识，AI 时代纯清洁在缩，早点练方案。
从「做基础」升级成「方案 + 仪器」，学皮肤管理。
突出客护与亲和力，写清跟过哪些项目。
选人别只看手法，要看有没有经营脑子。能养客的骨干值得给高提成。

ai_s7_trends: 家用仪器外移基础。
到店体验与方案带来机会。
有方案力的专员更抢手。

body: 护肤专员在美容与医美机构为客人提供皮肤清洁、补水、修复与基础护理，结合产品与仪器给出个性化护肤建议。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 测肤和家用仪能辅助，但手法、方案与到店体验还是专员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can clean data and generate tables, but assistants still decide which questions to ask and how to interpret the results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 40,600 research assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 42,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,700 jobs, with about 5,200 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $58,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace social science research assistants, but it will absorb entry-level data cleaning. Automation accelerates cleaning messy data and generating tables, shifting assistants from checking spreadsheets to research design, sampling strategy, and interpreting results. Those who only clean data face displacement, while people who understand methods and can interpret findings are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Research design: people frame the questions.
Sampling strategy: people assess bias.
Interpreting results: people determine meaning.
Field sample collection: trust depends on people.
Communication and reporting: people explain the conclusions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range. Systems accelerate cleaning and table generation, but people retain an essential role in design and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is the act of cleaning data and generating tables, not the research support role itself. People who understand methods and can interpret findings become scarcer as productivity rises. Assistants who only clean data face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Social science students should practice statistics and research methods. Data-cleaning work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop design skills early.
Advance from data cleaning to design plus interpretation, and learn statistics and software.
Highlight project and analytical experience, clearly describing the data you have worked with.
When hiring, look beyond proficiency and assess whether candidates think methodologically.

ai_s7_trends: Data cleaning becomes fully automated
Statistical skills become standard
People who can design studies and interpret findings are in greater demand

body: Social science research assistants help researchers conduct social surveys and experiments. They coordinate sampling, data collection and cleaning, statistical analysis, and literature reviews, turning research questions into analyzable data and reports.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can clean data and generate tables, but assistants still decide which questions to ask and how to interpret the results.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能清数据与跑表，但哪题该问、结果怎么解读，还是助理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年科学助理在岗约 4.06 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.23 万人，净增约 0.17 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.52 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.80 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代社科研究助理，但会吃掉初级清洗。自动化把脏数清理、跑表提速，助理从「对表」挪向「研究设计、样本策略、结果解读」。真正被挤掉的是只做清数的，懂方法能解读的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 研究设计：问题靠人。
样本策略：偏倚靠人。
结果解读：意义靠人。
现场收样：信任靠人。
沟通汇报：结论靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——清洗与跑表被系统加速，但设计与解读还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「清数跑表」动作，不是「研究支撑」的岗位。懂方法、能解读的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做清数的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 社科多练统计与方法，AI 时代清数在缩，早点练设计。
从「清数」升级成「设计 + 解读」，学统计与软件。
突出项目与分析，写清跑过哪些数据。
选人别只看熟练，要看有没有方法脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 清洗全面自动化
统计成标配
能设计会解读的人更抢手

body: 社科研究助理协助研究者开展社会调查与实验，统筹抽样、数据收集与清洗、统计分析与文献整理，把研究问题落成可分析的数据与报告。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能清数据与跑表，但哪题该问、结果怎么解读，还是助理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can handle filings and collection reminders, but people still decide whether a deduction is valid and how to explain it to the taxpayer.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 57,600 tax examiners, collectors, and revenue agents were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 56,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,100 jobs, with about 4,300 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $59,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tax examiners and collectors, but it will redesign tax administration. Once systems handle information matching, delinquency reminders, and document generation, personnel shift from data entry toward audit judgment, dispute resolution, and compliance oversight. The truly scarce professionals can examine accounts, resolve disputes, and safeguard procedures.
ai_s2_auto: Automated matching of tax return information
Automated delivery of tax delinquency reminders
Automated generation of documents and notices
ai_s3_list: Audit judgment: people examine accounts to explain differences.
Dispute resolution: people interpret the law.
On-site audits: people reconcile records with reality.
Compliance oversight: people safeguard procedures.
Final accountability: people answer for incorrect assessments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure area of tax administration. Systems and algorithms replace standardized actions, but people retain an essential role in audits and resolution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is entry and reminders, not the occupation itself. People who can examine accounts, resolve disputes, and understand procedures become scarcer as automated triage expands. Those who only enter data mechanically and do not learn new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in taxation, accounting, and law and master CPA material and tax law while in school. Pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so develop account-examination and audit skills early.
Advance from collection to audit judgment. Learn data analysis and legal rules and seek a transfer into auditing or supervision rather than remaining in mechanical collections.
Highlight account-examination and dispute experience and specify the cases you have handled. Audit and system experience is preferred.
When hiring, assess integrity and account-examination ability, not only data-entry skills. Personnel who can audit independently and accept responsibility deserve strong compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Electronic tax bureaus continue to divert standardized tax administration.
Big-data case selection and audits place greater weight on people.
Multidisciplinary personnel who can examine accounts and understand data are in greater demand.

body: Tax examiners, collectors, and revenue agents review tax returns, deductions, and credits, compare third-party data to identify differences, collect delinquent taxes, resolve disputes, and enforce tax administration compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can handle filings and collection reminders, but people still decide whether a deduction is valid and how to explain it to the taxpayer.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 申报和催缴能交给系统，但「这笔抵扣该不该认、怎么跟纳税人讲」，还得人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年税务审查、征收与税务代理人员在岗约 5.76 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.65 万人，岗位净减约 0.11 万个，年均产生约 0.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代税务稽查与征收人员，但会重做征管流程。信息比对、欠税提醒、文书生成交给系统后，人员从「录数」挪向「稽查判断、争议处置与合规把关」。真正稀缺的是能查账、定争议、守程序的人。
ai_s2_accel: 风险纳税人的智能评分
ai_s2_auto: 第三方数据的自动勾稽
文书与通知的自动生成
ai_s3_list: 稽查判断：差异靠人查账。
争议处置：法条靠人定。
现场稽查：账实靠人核。
合规把关：程序靠人守。
责任兜底：错核要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的征管区——标准化动作被系统和算法替代，但稽查与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录入和提醒」，不是「岗位」。会查账、能定争议、懂程序的人，反而随自动分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只做机械录数、不学新系统的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 财税法律打底，在校把注会和税法学通。AI 时代纯录入在缩，早点练查账和稽查。
从「征收」升级成「稽查判断」，学数据和法条，争取转稽查或主管，别停留在机械催缴。
突出查账和争议经验，写清办过哪些案。有稽查和系统经验优先。
招人看原则性和查账力，不止看录入。能独立稽查、敢担责的人员值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 电子税务局持续分流标准化征管。
大数据选案与稽查更重人。
会查账懂数据的复合人员更抢手。

body: 税务审查、征收与税务代理人员是税务稽查与征收人员审核纳税申报与扣除抵免，比对第三方数据核查差异，追缴欠税并处置纳税争议，执行税收征管合规。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 申报和催缴能交给系统，但「这笔抵扣该不该认、怎么跟纳税人讲」，还得人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An AI audio guide can describe the Forbidden City with perfect diction, but when an older passenger suddenly feels ill or a child goes missing, visitors need a guide, not headphones.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 55,800 tour guides and escorts were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 60,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,500 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 13,000 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $36,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tour guides, but it will take work from guides who only recite scripts. Audio tours, AI narration, and itinerary apps already handle standardized explanations and reservations. What remains is the guide who adapts on the spot, energizes a group, and adds human warmth to a journey. These capabilities depend on genuine interpersonal interaction that AI cannot provide.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time translation devices assist foreign-language tours
Attraction crowd forecasts and off-peak recommendations
Livestreamed tours and online travel content
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate itinerary plans and route recommendations
Automatically play audio explanations and attraction introductions
ai_s3_list: Improvisation: tell a joke or story that resonates with visitors.
Emergency response: handle lost travelers, illness, injury, and complaints on site.
Emotional engagement: energize a quiet group.
Human warmth: remember visitors' preferences and needs.
Itinerary flexibility: make last-minute adjustments that improve the experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means digital tools have eroded the information side of tour guiding: apps can replace explanations, reservations, and routes. Yet 4 also shows that AI replaces information, not people; improvisation, emotional engagement, and human warmth remain human strengths.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not guarantee safety. Guides who do no preparation and only recite scripts will eventually be replaced by AI narration. Use AI to research, build itineraries, and learn languages, then devote your energy to livelier stories and more attentive service.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Passing the national tour guide qualification exam is the first step, but language and presentation training matter more. Families should understand that this career has clear peak and off seasons and volatile income. Complementary study in tourism planning or educational travel is advisable.

Move toward nonstandard experiences such as educational tours, in-depth cultural travel, premium customization, and outbound tour leadership, areas AI cannot replace. Use AI for itineraries and translation while reserving your energy for the live experience.

People with strong foreign-language skills or a passion for travel often transition into tour guiding. Earn the qualification first, then intern on tours. In an interview, a story about rescuing a difficult situation or energizing a group is more persuasive than a certificate.

Good guides are scarce. Retain them with guaranteed pay, commissions, and peak-season bonuses. Train guides in product design so they advance from narrators to itinerary designers, improving both retention and the product.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Attendance and notifications at meeting points
Lead livestreamed tours and promote destinations
Respond to positive reviews and analyze data
Collect satisfaction data and conduct reviews

ai_s7_trends: As in-depth, educational, and customized travel grows, guides who can design experiences become more valuable.
AI narrators eliminate script-reading guides, making human warmth the central competitive advantage.
Digital tourism makes online customer acquisition and livestreamed tours routine.

body: Tour guides and escorts lead visitors, provide narration, and coordinate itineraries. They introduce attractions, arrange schedules, tickets, and lodging, protect visitor safety, and address unexpected problems so travelers complete their journeys safely and enjoyably.
career_ai_description_block.heading: An AI audio guide can describe the Forbidden City with perfect diction, but when an older passenger suddenly feels ill or a child goes missing, visitors need a guide, not headphones.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 讲解器能把故宫讲得字正腔圆，但「车上的大爷突然身体不适、小朋友走丢了」——这种时候，游客需要的不是耳机，是导游。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年导游和陪同人员在岗约 5.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.03 万人，净增约 0.45 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代导游，但会抢走「只会念稿」的导游的饭碗：语音导览、AI 讲解、行程 App 已经把标准化讲解和预订做掉了。真正留下来的，是能临场应变、能调动气氛、能给行程注入人情味的导游——这些能力建立在真实的人际互动上，AI 给不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 定制行程与预算建议
实时翻译设备辅助外语讲解
景区人流预测与错峰建议
直播带团与线上文旅内容
ai_s2_auto: 行程规划与路线推荐自动生成
语音讲解与景点介绍自动播报
门票预订与核销线上化
行程确认与通知消息自动化
ai_s3_list: 临场发挥：一个梗、一个故事讲到游客心坎里。
突发处理：走失、伤病、投诉的现场应对。
情绪调动：把沉闷的团带热起来。
人情味：记住游客的喜好与需求。
行程灵活：临时调整让体验更好。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明导游的工作「信息面」已被数字化侵蚀——讲解、预订、路线都能用 App 替代；但 4 分恰恰说明，AI 只能替代「信息」，替代不了「人」：临场、情绪、人情味这些核心价值，是 AI 学不会的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不意味着安全：不做功课、只会念稿的导游，迟早被 AI 讲解器取代。把 AI 当帮手（查资料、做行程、学外语），把力气花在「讲得更活、服务更细」上，才是这行的出路。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想当导游，考证（全国导游资格证）是第一步，但更重要的是语言和表达训练；提醒孩子这行淡旺季明显、收入波动大，家里要有心理预期，建议辅修旅游策划或研学教育方向。
往「非标体验」走：研学团、深度文化游、高端定制、出境领队，这些都是 AI 替代不了的赛道；把 AI 用于行程和翻译，把精力留给现场。
外语好或爱旅游的人转导游很常见，先考证再跟团实习；面试时讲一个你「现场救场」或「把团带嗨」的故事，比证书更能打动人。
好导游是稀缺资源，建议用「保底+提成+旺季奖励」留人；给导游做产品设计培训，让他们从「讲解员」升级成「行程设计师」，人留住了产品也升级了。

ai_s7_trends: 深度游、研学游、定制游兴起，会设计的导游更吃香。
